identity_lookup.name: entity_lookup_by_id
identity_lookup.description: Reads the full identity entity record by entity ID to inspect aliases, policies, and merge outcomes.

path_params.identity_id: login response auth.entity_id or token lookup data.entity_id

response_fields.data.name: Canonical entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: All aliases attached to the entity across auth mounts
response_fields.data.policies: Policies attached directly to the entity

permission_check.name: read_jwt_role_config
permission_check.description: Reads the JWT/OIDC role configuration to confirm active claim constraints and granted policies after setup or mutation.

access_test.name: read_secret_kv_v2
access_test.description: Attempts to read a KV v2 secret with the session token to verify effective authorization.

response_fields.data.data: Returned secret payload if access is granted

session_token_inspect.name: token_lookup_self
session_token_inspect.description: Returns the current session token's identity, TTL, expiry, policies, and remaining use count for post-sequence analysis.

response_fields.data.entity_id: Vault identity entity bound to the session
response_fields.data.display_name: Display name used for identity comparison
response_fields.data.policies: Policies granted directly to the token
response_fields.data.meta: Auth metadata copied from login context
response_fields.data.num_uses: Remaining or configured token use budget

admin_audit.name: entity_lookup_by_name
admin_audit.description: Reads the full identity entity record by entity name to cross-check name-based identity resolution.

path_params.name: entity name from prior entity read or lookup

response_fields.data.id: Canonical entity ID for the named entity
response_fields.data.name: Entity name

admin_audit.name: group_lookup_by_id
admin_audit.description: Reads an identity group by ID to inspect policies and membership used in group alias authorization tests.

admin_audit.name: group_alias_lookup_by_id
admin_audit.description: Reads a group alias by ID to confirm external group name to internal group binding.

path_params.id: group alias ID from create_group_alias response

response_fields.data.name: External group alias name
response_fields.data.canonical_id: Internal group ID targeted by the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor the alias belongs to
